supporting_art_contract.prompt_template: Text-free vertical editorial supporting art for a Korean economics card. Show [subject and visual metaphor]. Keep all factual marks separate and code-native. Apply the selected recipe's style tokens and palette bindings.
negative_constraints: No legible words, letters, numerals, logos, flags, chart, axes, or UI.
Keep the upper 32% quiet and low-detail for a later headline overlay; place the hero art in the middle/lower area.
Charts, data values, labels, citations, and factual annotations stay code-native.
supporting_art_contract.model_evidence: E1 generated one sample per style with GPT Image 2.5 Flare. fal returned HTTP 403 for all attempted calls; cross-model comparison is pending. No provider winner or reproducibility claim is supported.

editorial-minimal.generation_direction: Restrained magazine composition; generous negative space; one clear subject; quiet material texture. No ornamental mini dashboards or icon grids. Typography remains in reserved compositor regions.

dark-data.generation_direction: High-contrast dark editorial composition with restrained mint accents. Illustration supports rather than competes with evidence. Never invent KPI tiles, chart marks, performance percentages, or product brands.

pop-collage.generation_direction: Expressive paper collage with pink/orange/blue accents, torn edges, playful brush texture and one dominant silhouette. Restrict collage to its supplied content slot; no factual copy, faux numbers, logos, robot cliches or unrelated slogans unless specifically requested.

theme.font_family: 'Noto Sans KR', 'Noto Sans CJK KR', sans-serif

r4-photo-fullbleed.generation_direction: R4 owner-preferred photo-led editorial direction. Use the supplied strong source photo as the full-bleed visual whenever present, preserving the original pixels and recording crop/focal-point decisions. Keep factual text in the existing deterministic compositor regions. Do not replace a suitable photo with generated illustration. If a usable photo is absent or weak, resolve to R7 before rendering.

theme.font_family: 'Noto Sans KR', 'Noto Sans CJK KR', sans-serif

r7-illustration-fallback.generation_direction: R7 owner-preferred illustration fallback for weak or absent photo assets, and for lifestyle/practical-information content. Use one centered, large subject with clean color blocks and restrained highlighter accents. Keep all exact text, numbers, citations and labels in the deterministic compositor; never render them into the illustration.
